title_en: Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting the Transformation of Scientific and Technological Achievements

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted for the purpose of promoting the transformation of scientific and technological achievements into real productive forces, regulating the transformation activities of scientific and technological achievements, accelerating scientific and technological progress, and promoting economic construction and social development.

Article 2 For the purposes of this Law, "scientific and technological achievements" means achievements with practical value resulting from scientific research and technological development. "Job-related scientific and technological achievements" means scientific and technological achievements made in the course of performing tasks of research and development institutions, institutions of higher education, enterprises and other entities, or mainly by using the material and technical conditions of the aforesaid entities.
For the purposes of this Law, "transformation of scientific and technological achievements" means activities such as follow-up experiments, development, application, and promotion of scientific and technological achievements until new technologies, new techniques, new materials, new products are formed and new industries are developed for the purpose of raising the level of productive forces.

Article 3 The transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall be conducive to accelerating the implementation of the innovation-driven development strategy, promoting the integration of science and technology with the economy, improving economic and social benefits, protecting the environment and rationally utilizing resources, and facilitating economic construction, social development and the maintenance of national security.
The transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall respect market rules, give play to the principal role of enterprises, follow the principles of voluntariness, mutual benefit, fairness, and good faith, and enjoy rights and bear risks in accordance with laws, regulations and contractual agreements. The intellectual property rights in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall be protected by law.
The transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall comply with laws and regulations, safeguard national interests, and shall not harm the public interest or the lawful rights and interests of others.

Article 4 The State shall make reasonable arrangements for the investment of fiscal funds in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, guide the investment of social funds, and promote the diversification of capital investment in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 5 The State Council and local people's governments at all levels shall strengthen the coordination of policies on science and technology, finance, investment, taxation, human resources, industry, finance, government procurement, military-civilian integration, etc., to create a favorable environment for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
Local people's governments at all levels may, in accordance with the principles stipulated in this Law and in light of local conditions, adopt more favorable measures to promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 6 The State encourages the implementation of scientific and technological achievements first within the territory of China. Where a Chinese entity or individual transfers or licenses scientific and technological achievements to an organization or individual outside China for implementation, it shall comply with relevant laws, administrative regulations, and relevant provisions of the State.

Article 7 For the needs of national security, national interests, and major social public interests, the State may, according to law, organize the implementation or license others to implement relevant scientific and technological achievements.

Article 8 The administrative department for science and technology under the State Council, the comprehensive economic administration department, and other relevant administrative departments shall, in accordance with the functions prescribed by the State Council, manage, guide and coordinate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
Local people's governments at all levels shall be responsible for managing, guiding and coordinating the transformation of scientific and technological achievements within their respective administrative regions.

Article 9 The State Council and local people's governments at all levels shall incorporate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements into national economic and social development plans, and organize and coordinate the implementation of the transformation of relevant scientific and technological achievements.

Article 10 Where applied science and technology projects and other related science and technology projects are established using fiscal funds, the relevant administrative departments and management agencies shall improve and perfect the way of organizing and managing scientific research, and shall listen to the opinions of relevant industries and enterprises when formulating relevant science and technology plans, programs, and compiling project guidelines; when organizing and implementing applied science and technology projects, they shall specify the obligations of the project undertakers regarding the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, strengthen intellectual property management, and take the transformation of scientific and technological achievements and the creation and utilization of intellectual property as important content and basis for project approval and acceptance.

Article 11 The State shall establish and improve the science and technology report system and the scientific and technological achievements information system, make public information on the implementation of science and technology projects and scientific and technological achievements and related intellectual property rights information, and provide public services such as inquiry and screening of scientific and technological achievements information. The disclosure of relevant information shall not divulge State secrets or trade secrets. For information not to be disclosed, the relevant departments shall promptly inform the relevant project undertakers.
The undertakers of science and technology projects established using fiscal funds shall, in accordance with regulations, submit relevant science and technology reports in a timely manner, and submit and aggregate information on scientific and technological achievements and related intellectual property rights to the scientific and technological achievements information system.
The State encourages the undertakers of science and technology projects established using non-fiscal funds to submit relevant science and technology reports and submit and aggregate information on scientific and technological achievements and related intellectual property rights to the scientific and technological achievements information system, and the departments of the people's governments at or above the county level responsible for relevant work shall provide them with convenience.

Article 13 The State, through formulating policies and measures, advocates and encourages the adoption of advanced technologies, techniques and equipment, and continuously improves, restricts the use of or eliminates backward technologies, techniques and equipment.

Article 14 The State shall strengthen standard-setting work, formulate national standards and industry standards for new technologies, new techniques, new materials and new products in a timely manner according to law, actively participate in the formulation of international standards, and promote the dissemination and application of advanced and applicable technologies.
The State shall establish an effective system for the mutual transformation of military and civilian scientific and technological achievements, and perfect the institutional mechanisms for collaborative innovation in defense science and technology. In the scientific research and production of military products, advanced and applicable civilian standards shall be adopted as a priority according to law, and the mutual transfer and transformation of military and civilian technologies shall be promoted.

Article 15 For key projects for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements organized and implemented by people's governments at all levels, the relevant departments may organize the transformation by means of open tendering. The relevant departments shall provide the successful bidder with the funding or other conditions determined at the time of tendering.

Article 17 The State encourages research and development institutions and institutions of higher education to transfer scientific and technological achievements to enterprises or other organizations by means of transfer, licensing or investment as value.
Research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State shall strengthen the management, organization and coordination of the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, promote the building of teams for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, optimize the process of transformation of scientific and technological achievements, and carry out technology transfer through their own institutions responsible for technology transfer work or by entrusting independent service institutions for transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 18 Research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State may decide on their own to transfer, license or invest as value the scientific and technological achievements they hold, but shall determine the price through methods such as negotiated pricing, listing and trading in the technology trading market, or auction. Where price is determined through negotiation, the name of the scientific and technological achievement and the proposed transaction price shall be publicized within the unit.

Article 19 For job-related scientific and technological achievements obtained by research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State, the persons who have accomplished or participated in the achievements may, without changing the ownership of the job-related scientific and technological achievements, transform the scientific and technological achievements according to the agreement with the unit, and enjoy the rights and interests stipulated in the agreement. The unit shall support the aforementioned transformation activities of scientific and technological achievements.
The person who accomplished the scientific and technological achievements or the person in charge of the project shall not hinder the transformation of job-related scientific and technological achievements, nor shall he/she take the job-related scientific and technological achievements and their technical materials and data as his/her own, thereby infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of the unit.

Article 20 The competent departments of research and development institutions and institutions of higher education, as well as the finance, science and technology and other relevant administrative departments, shall establish a performance appraisal and evaluation system conducive to promoting the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, take the situation of transformation of scientific and technological achievements as one of the important contents and bases for the evaluation of relevant units and personnel and for the support of scientific research funds, and increase scientific research fund support for relevant units and personnel with outstanding performance in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
Research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State shall establish a system for professional title evaluation, post management, and assessment and evaluation that conforms to the characteristics of the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, and perfect the incentive and restraint mechanism for income distribution.

Article 21 Research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State shall submit to their competent departments an annual report on the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, stating the number of scientific and technological achievements obtained by the unit according to law, the implementation of transformation, and the relevant income distribution. The competent department shall, in accordance with regulations, submit the annual report on the transformation of scientific and technological achievements to the finance, science and technology and other relevant administrative departments.

Article 22 For the purpose of adopting new technologies, new techniques, new materials and producing new products, an enterprise may publish information on its own or entrust a science and technology intermediary service agency to solicit the scientific and technological achievements it needs, or seek partners for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
The science and technology administrative department of local people's governments at or above the county level and other relevant departments shall, in accordance with the division of functions, provide assistance and support to enterprises in obtaining the required scientific and technological achievements.

Article 23 An enterprise has the right according to law to implement the transformation of scientific and technological achievements independently or jointly with domestic and foreign enterprises, institutions and other partners.
An enterprise may, through fair competition, undertake independently or jointly with other units the projects of scientific research and development and transformation of scientific and technological achievements organized by the government.

Article 24 For science and technology projects established using fiscal funds that have market application prospects and clear industrial objectives, the relevant government departments and management agencies shall give play to the leading role of enterprises in the selection of research and development directions, project implementation, and application of achievements, and encourage enterprises, research and development institutions, institutions of higher education and other organizations to jointly implement them.

Article 25 The State encourages research and development institutions and institutions of higher education to cooperate with enterprises to jointly implement the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
Research and development institutions and institutions of higher education may participate in the bidding activities organized by relevant government departments or enterprises for the implementation of the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 26 The State encourages enterprises, research and development institutions, institutions of higher education and other organizations to adopt industry-university-research cooperation methods such as jointly establishing research and development platforms, technology transfer institutions or technology innovation alliances, to jointly carry out activities such as research and development, achievement application and promotion, and standard research and formulation.
All parties to the cooperation shall sign an agreement, agreeing according to law on matters such as the organizational form of cooperation, division of tasks, capital investment, ownership of intellectual property rights, distribution of rights and interests, risk sharing, and liability for breach of contract.

Article 27 The State encourages research and development institutions, institutions of higher education, enterprises and other organizations to conduct exchanges of scientific and technical personnel, and according to the characteristics of the profession and the needs of technological development in the industry, engage scientific and technical personnel from enterprises and other organizations to work part-time in teaching and scientific research, and support their own scientific and technical personnel to work in enterprises and other organizations to engage in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 28 The State supports enterprises in cooperating with research and development institutions, institutions of higher education, vocational schools and training institutions to jointly establish student internship and practice training bases and graduate research practice work institutions, and jointly cultivate specialized technical talents and highly-skilled personnel.

Article 29 The State encourages agricultural scientific research institutions and agricultural experiment and demonstration units to independently or cooperate with other units to implement the transformation of agricultural scientific and technological achievements.

Article 30 The State shall cultivate and develop the technology market, encourage the establishment of science and technology intermediary service agencies, and provide trading venues, information platforms, and services such as information retrieval, processing and analysis, evaluation, and brokerage for technology transactions.
When providing services, science and technology intermediary service agencies shall follow the principles of fairness and objectivity, shall not provide false information or certifications, and shall have the obligation to keep confidential the State secrets and the trade secrets of the parties that they come to know during the service process.

Article 31 The State supports the construction of public research and development platforms according to the needs of industrial and regional development, and provides services such as technology integration, common technology research and development, pilot tests and industrial tests, systematization and engineering development of scientific and technological achievements, and technology promotion and demonstration for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 32 The State supports the development of technology business incubators, university science and technology parks and other technology business incubation institutions, and provides services such as incubation space, entrepreneurial guidance, research and development and management consulting for start-up technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises.

Article 33 Fiscal funds for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall mainly be used for guiding funds, loan interest subsidies, subsidy funds and venture capital for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, as well as other capital purposes for promoting the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 34 The State shall implement tax incentives for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements in accordance with the provisions of relevant tax laws and administrative regulations.

Article 35 The State encourages banking financial institutions to innovate in terms of organizational form, management mechanism, financial products and services, encourages the development of loan businesses such as intellectual property pledge loans and equity pledge loans, and provides financial support for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
The State encourages policy-based financial institutions to take measures to increase financial support for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 36 The State encourages insurance institutions to develop insurance products that meet the characteristics of the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, and provide insurance services for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.

Article 37 The State shall improve the multi-level capital market, and support enterprises in financing for projects of transformation of scientific and technological achievements through direct financing methods such as equity transactions and the issuance of stocks and bonds according to law.

Article 38 The State encourages venture capital institutions to invest in projects for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements.
The venture capital guidance fund established by the State shall guide and support venture capital institutions to invest in start-up technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises.

Article 39 The State encourages the establishment of transformation funds or venture funds for scientific and technological achievements, the sources of which shall be provided by the State, local governments, enterprises, institutions and other organizations or individuals, for supporting the transformation of scientific and technological achievements with high investment, high risk and high output, and accelerating the industrialization of major scientific and technological achievements.
The establishment of transformation funds and venture funds for scientific and technological achievements and the use of their funds shall be subject to the relevant provisions of the State.

Article 40 Where a unit that has accomplished scientific and technological achievements cooperates with other units in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, the ownership of the relevant rights and interests in the scientific and technological achievements shall be stipulated by contract according to law. If the contract does not stipulate, the following principles shall apply:
(1) if no new invention or creation is made during the cooperative transformation, the rights and interests in the scientific and technological achievements shall belong to the unit that accomplished the scientific and technological achievements;
(2) if new inventions or creations are made during the cooperative transformation, the rights and interests in the new inventions or creations shall be jointly owned by all parties to the cooperation; and
(3) for the scientific and technological achievements made during the cooperative transformation, each party shall have the right to implement the scientific and technological achievements, and the transfer of such scientific and technological achievements shall be subject to the consent of all parties to the cooperation.

Article 41 Where a unit that has accomplished scientific and technological achievements cooperates with other units in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, all parties to the cooperation shall reach an agreement on keeping technical secrets confidential; the parties shall not, in violation of the agreement or the requirements of the right holder regarding keeping technical secrets confidential, disclose or allow others to use the technology.

Article 42 Enterprises and institutions shall establish and improve a technical secret protection system to protect their own technical secrets. Employees shall abide by the technical secret protection system of their unit.
Enterprises and institutions may sign agreements with relevant personnel participating in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements on keeping the technical secrets of the unit confidential during their term of office or for a certain period after resignation, retirement, or retirement from work; the relevant personnel shall not violate the agreements, disclose the technical secrets of the unit, or engage in the same transformation activities of scientific and technological achievements as those of the original unit.
Employees shall not transfer or covertly transfer job-related scientific and technological achievements without authorization.

Article 43 The income obtained by research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State from the transformation of scientific and technological achievements shall be entirely retained by the unit, and after rewarding and remunerating the personnel who have made important contributions to the completion and transformation of job-related scientific and technological achievements, shall be mainly used for scientific and technological research and development and transformation of achievements and other related work.

Article 44 After the transformation of job-related scientific and technological achievements, the unit that accomplished the scientific and technological achievements shall give rewards and remuneration to the personnel who have made important contributions to the completion and transformation of the scientific and technological achievements.
The unit that accomplished the scientific and technological achievements may stipulate or agree with the scientific and technical personnel on the method, amount and time limit of rewards and remuneration. When formulating relevant provisions, the unit shall fully solicit the opinions of its scientific and technical personnel, and make the relevant provisions public within the unit.

Article 45 Where the unit that accomplished the scientific and technological achievements has not stipulated or agreed with the scientific and technical personnel on the method and amount of rewards and remuneration, it shall give rewards and remuneration to the personnel who have made important contributions to the completion and transformation of job-related scientific and technological achievements according to the following standards:
(1) where the job-related scientific and technological achievements are transferred or licensed to others for implementation, no less than 50% of the net income from the transfer or licensing of the scientific and technological achievements shall be extracted;
(2) where the job-related scientific and technological achievements are used as investment, no less than 50% of the shares or capital contribution ratios formed by the scientific and technological achievements shall be extracted; and
(3) where the job-related scientific and technological achievements are implemented by the unit itself or jointly with others, no less than 5% of the operating profit from the implementation of the scientific and technological achievements shall be extracted each year for three to five consecutive years after the transformation and implementation have been successfully put into production.
The methods and amounts of rewards and remuneration stipulated by research and development institutions and institutions of higher education established by the State or agreed with scientific and technical personnel shall meet the standards set forth in items (1) to (3) of the preceding paragraph.
The expenditures of state-owned enterprises and institutions on giving rewards and remuneration to personnel who have made important contributions to the completion and transformation of job-related scientific and technological achievements in accordance with this Law shall be included in the total wage bill of the unit for the current year, but shall not be subject to the limitation of the total wage bill of the unit for the current year and shall not be included in the base of the total wage bill of the unit.

Article 46 Where the undertaker of a science and technology project established using fiscal funds fails to submit a science and technology report or submit and aggregate information on scientific and technological achievements and related intellectual property rights in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the relevant government department or management agency that organizes and implements the project shall order it to make corrections; if the circumstances are serious, it shall be given a notice of criticism and be prohibited from undertaking any science and technology project established using fiscal funds within a certain period.
Where a research and development institution or institution of higher education established by the State fails to submit an annual report on the transformation of scientific and technological achievements in accordance with the provisions of this Law, its competent department shall order it to make corrections; if the circumstances are serious, it shall be given a notice of criticism.

Article 47 Any person who, in violation of the provisions of this Law, practices fraud in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, uses deceptive means to obtain rewards and honorary titles, defraud money, or seek illegal profits shall be ordered by the relevant government department to make corrections according to its management functions, the rewards and honorary titles shall be revoked, the illegal gains shall be confiscated, and a fine shall be imposed. If economic losses are caused to others, the person shall bear civil liability for compensation according to law. If a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 48 Where a science and technology service agency or its personnel, in violation of the provisions of this Law, intentionally provides false information, experimental results or evaluation opinions to deceive the parties, or colludes with one party to deceive the other party, the relevant government department shall order it to make corrections according to its management functions, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine; if the circumstances are serious, the administrative department for industry and commerce shall revoke the business license according to law. If economic losses are caused to others, it shall bear civil liability for compensation according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Where a science and technology intermediary service agency or its personnel, in violation of the provisions of this Law, divulges State secrets or the trade secrets of the parties, it shall bear corresponding legal liability in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 49 Where the administrative department for science and technology and other relevant departments and their staff members abuse their power, neglect their duties, or engage in malpractices for personal gain in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, the appointing authority or the supervisory authority shall impose sanctions on the directly responsible persons in charge and other directly liable persons according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 50 Any person who, in violation of the provisions of this Law, appropriates the scientific and technological achievements of others by means such as inducing theft, luring or coercion, thereby infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of others, shall bear civil liability for compensation according to law, and may be subject to a fine; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 51 Any employee who, in violation of the provisions of this Law, discloses the entity's technical secrets without the permission of the entity, or transfers or transfers in disguised form service-related scientific and technological achievements without authorization, or any relevant person participating in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements who violates the agreement with the entity and engages in the same transformation of scientific and technological achievements as the original entity within the agreed period after resignation, retirement, or leave of absence, thereby causing economic losses to the entity, shall bear civil liability for compensation according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Article 52 This Law shall come into force as of October 1, 1996.
